Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: implementation sprite animation, not a concept sheet.
Reference image: Ilyra Voss costume/identity. Cream broad brim witch hat with black band, long silver braid, teal split-tail coat with gold trim, leather belt and reagent pouches, dark trousers and tall brown boots. Empty hands, no weapon. Character faces RIGHT in fixed three-quarter side view.
Style: larger detailed pixel art, strong consistent silhouette, restrained pixel clusters and controlled shading, no soft painted blur. Same character model, proportions, clothing details and camera in EVERY frame.
TRANSPARENT background, no labels, grid lines, ground, shadows, stage, props or extra characters. Each figure entirely inside its cell with generous transparent padding. FIXED scale, fixed camera, identical planted-feet baseline relative to each cell. Never zoom, crop, or resize a figure between frames.
Create ONE animation only: a subtle relaxed IDLE BREATHING LOOP, twelve sequential frames in EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, read left to right then downward. This entire sheet is one continuous cycle, not one cycle per row.
Both feet remain planted in the EXACT SAME position in all 12 cells. Hands hang relaxed beside belt throughout. Head faces right unchanged. Only tiny gradual chest breathing and gently lagging braid and coat hem movement. No turns, walking, attacks, poses or equipment changes.
Frame progression around a full breathing cycle: 1 neutral; 2 early inhale; 3 slight inhale; 4 rising chest; 5 nearly full inhale; 6 peak inhale; 7 beginning exhale; 8 mild exhale; 9 lowered chest; 10 near rest; 11 settling; 12 immediately before frame 1. Changes between adjacent frames must be very small, including frames 4-to-5 and 8-to-9 at row breaks, and 12-to-1. No identical duplicates, but maximum subtlety. All twelve frames should look almost identical when seen as still images.
Each sprite approximately same 260-pixel full height with broad transparent margins in a 4x3 landscape canvas. Exactly twelve full-body characters.

Create ONE animation only: RUN IN PLACE toward the RIGHT. SIXTEEN chronological frames arranged in EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS read left to right then downward. The whole 16-frame sheet is ONE full gait cycle containing exactly two alternating footfalls. Do not make a separate cycle on each row.
Anatomically coherent gait with smoothly swinging arms, bent elbows, moving hip/knee/ankle joints, slight vertical bob, constant forward torso lean, coat tails trailing left. Hip stays horizontally centered at the same x location in every cell. Head/hat size, boot size and limb lengths identical throughout. Near and far leg must alternate.
Frames 1-4: near foot front contact, weight compression, stance foot rolling back, rear foot lifts.
Frames 5-8: far knee passes forward, near toe pushes off, first airborne extension, far foot reaches front.
Frames 9-12: far foot front contact, weight compression, stance foot rolling back, near foot lifts.
Frames 13-16: near knee passes forward, far toe pushes off, second airborne extension, near foot reaches front just before frame 1.
Supply actual intermediate limb positions at every step. Last-to-first and row-to-row transitions must be as close as all other transitions. No jumping attack, no facing change, no held weapons, no unrelated poses. Exactly sixteen full-body figures, about 240 pixels high each, consistent scale and generous transparent gutters.

Reference image: Ilyra Voss costume/identity. Cream broad brim witch hat with black band, long silver braid, teal split-tail coat with gold trim, leather belt and reagent pouches, dark trousers and tall brown boots. Empty hands, no weapon. Character faces RIGHT in fixed three-quarter side view.

Create ONE animation only: STANDING TO CROUCH transition. TWELVE chronological frames in EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS read left to right then downward. A single continuous lowering action across all twelve frames, not one action per row. Do not stand back up in the last frames.
Start upright relaxed stance at frame 1, end in a deep stable combat crouch at frame 12. Both boots stay planted at the EXACT SAME x/y locations within their cells throughout. Bend hips and knees progressively; preserve thigh and shin lengths. Torso inclines slightly forward and arms come forward for balance. Hat/head remain same size; body gets shorter through joint bends, never squashing or shrinking.
Frame 1 upright; 2 barely unlock knees; 3 small knee bend; 4 slight lowering; 5 quarter crouch; 6 half crouch; 7 further lowering; 8 three-quarter crouch; 9 almost crouched; 10 deep crouch; 11 settling coat and braid; 12 stable deep crouch. Eased motion with small changes near endpoints. Keep hip horizontally centered. No damage flinch, no attack, no floor-sitting, no alternate stance, no held weapon.
Use identical cell size and fixed world-to-pixel scale for all poses, so empty space above the ducked frames increases naturally. Exactly twelve characters in 4x3 landscape canvas. The last four sprites are shorter because knees bend, not larger to fill their cells.
